Remark
[A group without a bi-invariant pseudo-metric]

Source: petersen:page-0058 ↗ def:pet-ch1-pseudo-riemannian ↗ def:pet-ch1-left-invariant-metric

1. ch1:1.6.29The matrices of $\operatorname {diag}(a^{-1},ab,1)$-type \[ \left[\begin{smallmatrix} a^{-1} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & ab & \ast \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\right], \qquad a>0,\quad b\in \mathbb {R}, \] form a two-dimensional Lie group that admits no bi-invariant pseudo-Riemannian metric.
